shift_history_subtitle: Past employee shifts. Cash drawer totals and variance are tracked per physical drawer, not per employee.
start_shift_subtitle: Choose how you will take payments. Cash payments need an open cash drawer shift.
shift_type_cash_drawer_help: Accept cash, wallet, card and bank payments
shift_type_non_cash_help: Wallet, card, bank and credit only
opening_amount_help: Enter the cash already in the drawer when you open it. Enter 0 if the drawer starts empty.
shift_overdue: This shift has been open for more than 12 hours. Please close the shift.
close_shift_help: Count the cash in the drawer and enter the total below.
variance_over_tolerance: That is over the {{tolerance}} tolerance and will be recorded in the audit log.
shift_closed_large_variance: Shift closed with a large variance of {{variance}}. This has been recorded in the audit log.
you_will_join_drawer: You will join the open drawer session. Your cash sales will be added to the same drawer.
drawer_open_not_shared: This drawer is already open and shared drawers are disabled. Ask the drawer owner to close it, or open a non-cash shift.
drawer_is_closed: The drawer is closed. Enter the opening float to open it with your shift.
drawer_not_available: You do not have permission to open a cash drawer shift.
manager_approval_required: A manager must approve joining this drawer.
manager_approval_join_help: This drawer is already open. A manager or admin must approve joining it.
non_cash_shift_notice: Non-cash shifts cannot accept cash payments, issue cash refunds, or perform drawer operations.
non_cash_shift_banner: This is a Non-Cash Shift. Cash payments are not allowed.
expected_hidden_until_count: Hidden until the drawer is counted
shared_drawer_note: You are sharing {{name}}'s drawer. Expected cash and variance belong to the drawer, not to your shift.
drawer_variance_closed: Drawer closed with a variance of {{variance}}.
non_cash_close_help: This shift took no cash, so there is nothing to count. Review the summary and close.
close_drawer_too: Close the physical drawer too (blind count)
blind_close_help: Expected cash is hidden until you submit the counted amount.
close_shift_only_help: Your shift will close, but the drawer stays open for the other employees using it.
shared_drawer_close_help: Only {{name}} can close this drawer. Your shift will close without closing the drawer.
safe_drop_help: Move excess cash from the drawer to the safe. Expected drawer cash decreases.
pay_in_help: Add cash to the drawer outside a sale, for example small change. Expected drawer cash increases.
pay_out_help: Remove cash from the drawer for a shop expense. A reason is required and expected cash decreases.
no_sale_open_help: Open the cash drawer without a sale. This does not change expected cash.
